content:
Asha (CS): FYI Maple Health renewal. they want to change term from 12mo -> 9mo and pay by card, but procurement insists on GL code + signed amendment to PO. missing: signed amendment, GL account code, billing contact. looping in @Ben and @Ravi
Ben (Sales): buyer DM: can we invoice 9 months pro-rated now and the rest as a separate renewal? procurement says they need a PO amendment with GL/CostCenter line. buyer prefers card for speed.
Ravi (Legal): legal note: any term change needs an amendment referencing original SOW and signed PO amendment. we can accept email consent + CEO sign-off as interim for card capture, but must follow up with signed amendment within 14 days. i'll draft a 1-paragraph amendment template.
Marta (Ops): ops needs exact GL/CostCenter code for ERP mapping, and a scanned PO amendment PDF before we finalize accounting. provisional GL ok for provisioning if buyer provides confirmation email. also need billing email.
Asha (CS): PO snippet from buyer DM:
```
PO#: MH-2026-557 (amendment pending)
Bill To: Maple Health Ltd
Original Term: 12mo
Requested Term: 9mo (prorate)
Seats: 200
Total (9mo): GBP 27,000
Billing contact: ap@maplehealth.co.uk
GL Code: (TBD)
```
Asha (CS): buyer says GL code is usually 4002-CC but will confirm with their finance team. they asked if we can accept card for month1 while they submit amendment.
acct-bot: draft invoice INV-MH-450 created GBP 27,000  status: draft, missing PO amendment. link: https://billing.internal/INV-MH-450
Ben (Sales): propose card tokenization for month1 with conditions: 1) email+CEO approval for interim 9mo term 2) signed PO amendment + GL code within 14 days 3) if amendment not received, we revert to original 12mo pricing or apply late amendment fee. legal ok?
Ravi (Legal): ok to proceed with card fallback under those conditions. i'll add clause: "Buyer shall deliver signed PO amendment including GL/CostCenter within 14 calendar days; failure permits Seller to bill retroactively or suspend services." will post draft.
Marta (Ops): ops workflow: on successful card charge we can provision seats but set account to "pending amendment" flag. ops will not push billing to ERP until PO amendment PDF received and GL code confirmed. provisional GL code accepted for provisioning only.
Asha (CS): action items: Asha ask buyer for scanned PO amendment, GL code, and billing email. Ben to escalate to buyer CFO if docs delayed. Ravi to drop amendment draft. Marta to prepare provisioning hold flag.
Ben (Sales): pinged buyer CFO. CFO reply: "we can provide GL code by EOD and sign amendment but legal needs 5 business days."
Asha (CS): customer-facing reply sent offering card + amendment flow. buyer asked: "can we provide GL code after card is charged?"
Ravi (Legal): GL code after charge is acceptable if included in signed amendment within 14 days. we need the signed document, not just an email.
acct-bot: scheduled: if no PO amendment by 2026-07-10T09:00Z, create proforma PRO-MH-450 and attempt card capture at 09:30Z next business day.
Marta (Ops): ops checklist: [ ] signed PO amendment (pdf) [ ] GL/CostCenter code (string) [ ] billing contact confirmed (email) [ ] SOW reference line. will mark complete when all received.
Asha (CS): timeline: if amendment + GL by Fri 17:00 UTC, proceed with standard 9mo invoice and onboarding. if not, run CC fallback tomorrow and route amendment for signature. will update thread when docs arrive. :thumbsup:
